description: Rebuild the architecture diagram from the official AWS icon set and update the docs to describe the real app. Add container/build_diagram.py (modeled on demo/session3/build_diagram.py) that embeds *_64.svg icons as data:image/svg+xml;base64 and depicts the runtime lane (User -> CloudFront -> ALB [imported VPC, SG locked to CloudFront prefix list] -> ECS Fargate -> DynamoDB orders + SSM loyalty rate) and the CI/CD lane (source.zip in S3 -> EventBridge -> CodePipeline -> CodeBuild docker build/push -> ECR -> EcsDeployAction rolling w/ circuit breaker -> ECS service). Overwrite container/architecture.svg, regenerate the top-level architecture.svg and architecture.png (rsvg-convert). Update README.md and FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md to describe order -> DynamoDB -> status RECEIVED/BREWING/READY -> recent-10, the SSM loyalty rate, boto3 now in the container, and the icon-built diagram. Ordered last because the docs describe FEAT-001/002/003; the diagram itself is independent of them.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/plan.md and .agents/tasks/context.json FIRST; also read /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/demo/session3/build_diagram.py as the layout/embed pattern (it is outside the worktree, read only).

Create /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/build_diagram.py: set ICON_BASE to /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/aws-icons/Architecture-Service-Icons_04302026 and reference these *_64.svg files: Arch_Networking-Content-Delivery/64/Arch_Amazon-CloudFront_64.svg, Arch_Networking-Content-Delivery/64/Arch_Elastic-Load-Balancing_64.svg, Arch_Containers/64/Arch_Amazon-Elastic-Container-Service_64.svg, Arch_Containers/64/Arch_AWS-Fargate_64.svg, Arch_Containers/64/Arch_Amazon-Elastic-Container-Registry_64.svg, Arch_Databases/64/Arch_Amazon-DynamoDB_64.svg, Arch_Management-Tools/64/Arch_AWS-Systems-Manager_64.svg, Arch_Developer-Tools/64/Arch_AWS-CodePipeline_64.svg, Arch_Developer-Tools/64/Arch_AWS-CodeBuild_64.svg, Arch_Storage/64/Arch_Amazon-Simple-Storage-Service_64.svg, Arch_Application-Integration/64/Arch_Amazon-EventBridge_64.svg. Embed each as data:image/svg+xml;base64 (read bytes, base64-encode). Output to container/architecture.svg next to the script.

Lay out two labeled lanes with the flows named in the description; keep it legible (zones, arrows, a short legend) following the session3 approach. Add a User node (an AWS General icon or a simple circle+label is fine).
Run python3 container/build_diagram.py to write container/architecture.svg; validate it parses as XML and contains >= 11 embedded icons.

Regenerate the top-level diagram: copy container/architecture.svg to /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/architecture.svg, and run rsvg-convert container/architecture.svg -o /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/architecture.png.

Update /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/README.md: describe the real app (order -> DynamoDB -> time-based status RECEIVED/BREWING/READY -> recent-10 list), SSM supplies the loyalty rate, the container now installs boto3 (no longer stdlib-only), and the diagram is built from official AWS icons. Keep ap-southeast-1 pinning, bootstrap-order, and cost sections accurate.

Update /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md so the demo narrative mentions placing an order, watching the status move RECEIVED -> BREWING -> READY, and the recent-orders list; keep the APP_VERSION bump demo (now v3-realapp) and the pipeline acts.
Commit locally on branch coffee-ship-realapp. NEVER push.
Set this FEAT status to completed.

README.md and FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md describe the order->DynamoDB->status->recent-10 flow, the SSM loyalty rate, boto3 in the container, and the icon-built diagram; ap-southeast-1 remains pinned.
